name: Dumbbell Clean and Press
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hinge with bent knees and a flat back to grip two dumbbells beside your shins.
Extend your hips and knees explosively while shrugging to pull the dumbbells up and catch them at shoulder height in a slight squat.
Stand tall, brace your core, and press both dumbbells straight overhead until your arms extend fully.
Lower the dumbbells smoothly back to your shoulders and then down beside your legs under control.
tips: Keep the dumbbells moving close to your body on the clean rather than swinging them forward.
Brace your glutes and abs during the overhead press to avoid overarching your lower back.
